quant.out_c: int32 two's complement, exact, one word per row

quant.in_a_flat: int8 two's complement, row-major A (M x K)
quant.in_b_flat: int8 two's complement, row-major B (K x N)
quant.out_c: int32 two's complement, exact, row-major C (M x N)

quant.in_w_flat: int8 two's complement, row-major filters (F x K)
quant.out_c: int32 two's complement, exact, row-major y (F x OUT_POS)

quant.in_x_flat: signed int8 two's complement, row-major ROWS x COLS
quant.out_c: int32 column index, zero-based; first (lowest) index wins ties
K int32 values, sign-extended, descending; duplicates retained

quant.in_x_flat: 8-bit bin IDs, restricted to 0 <= x < BINS (0..15)
quant.out_c: BINS exact nonnegative int32 counts, ascending bin order
quant.accumulator: counts include all LEN inputs; no saturation or wraparound

quant.in_x_flat: signed int8 image, row-major HEIGHT x WIDTH
quant.pooling: K x K maximum, stride 1, valid windows only (no padding)
